author: Davidgo5867

english.text: "Tom identifies as plural, polyamorous, enby otherkin." "Oh, that's a pretty extreme combo even for the cutting-edge SJW standards." "Come on, don't be such a fuddy-duddy!" "I don't know. It sounds very strange to me. I should probably watch more Netflix and spend more time on Mastodon to get used to such stuff. By the way, does he also identify as nudist?" "I don't think it's technically possible." "Why not? Isn't it marginalized enough?" "Because they're also an ardent member of the furry fandom. You won't often see them without a costume."

jyutping: 「tong1 mou5 jing6 wai4 zi6 gei2 hai6 fuk1 sou3，do1 cai1 zai3，jau4 kei4 taa1 can1 suk6。」「o2，zau6 syun3 hai6 zim1 dyun1 ge3 SJW biu1 zeon2，ni1 go3 dou1 hai6 jat1 go3 gei2 gik6 dyun1 ge3 zou2 hap6。」「lai4 laa1，m4 hou2 gam3 fai3 laa1！」「ngo5 m4 zi1。deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 teng1 lok6 hou3 kei4 gwaai3。ngo5 jing1 goi1 tai2 do1 di1 Netflix ，faa1 do1 di1 si4 gaan3 hai2 Mastodon dou6，dang2 keoi5 zaap6 gwaan3 ni1 di1 je5。seon6 bin2 gong2 haa2，keoi5 jik6 dou1 jing6 wai4 zi6 gei2 hai6 lo2 tai2 zyu2 ji6 ze2 maa1？」「ngo5 gok3 dak1 gei6 seot6 soeng6 hai6 m4 ho2 nang4 ge3。」「dim2 gaai2 m4 dak1？gam2 joeng2 m4 gau3 bin1 jyun4 faa3 me1？」「jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 jik6 dou1 hai6 mou4 jung4 jung4 ge3 fan2 si1。nei5 m4 wui5 seng4 jat6 gin3 dou2 keoi5 dei6 mou5 zoek6 fuk6 zong1。」
text: 「湯姆認為自己係複數，多妻制，由其他親屬。」「哦，就算係尖端嘅 SJW 標準，呢個都係一個幾極端嘅組合。」「嚟啦，唔好咁廢啦！」「我唔知。對我嚟講聽落好奇怪。我應該睇多啲 Netflix ，花多啲時間喺 Mastodon 度，等佢習慣呢啲嘢。順便講吓，佢亦都認為自己係裸體主義者嗎？」「我覺得技術上係唔可能嘅。」「點解唔得？噉樣唔夠邊緣化咩？」「因為佢哋亦都係毛茸茸嘅粉絲。你唔會成日見到佢哋冇着服裝。」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: This winter has been warmer than usual, so far, without snow, here on Lulu Island. In the morning, this 27th of December of 2024, I walked twice to Tim Hortons: Firstly, I ate two hash browns with an oat milk iced coffee. Secondly, I ate a sausage egg English muffin meal, including a hash brown and oat milk iced coffee. I went to Starbucks for an oat nog latte. I missed Greg, my Filipino friend, who left just before me. Then, I went to Yummy Slice pizzeria for a red-can Coca-Cola Zero Sugar. The Filipina vendor Rose was there, so we said "Happy New Year" to each other. I passed by Kin's Farm fruteria. On my way home, in the park's alleyway, I met and talked with my ufologist friend, Michael J., a Dane-French. He amused himself with the red touque on my head, with orange letters in Tagalog: "MGA AWSTRALYA ANG MGA ESTRELYA" (The stars are Australias). I told him it was about "space colonization." There are the cold and hot deserts of other worlds. Then, I went to the house of my "auntie" neighbour, Tita Zeny, to pick up her homemade "dinuguán" or Filipino pork blood stew to bring home. Lunch at home would include Filipino chicken "adobo."

jyutping: gam1 go3 dung1 tin1 wan1 nyun5 gwo3 ping4 si4，dou3 muk6 cin4 wai4 zi2，mou5 lok6 syut3，nei1 dou6 lou6 lou6 dou2。hai2 2024 nin4 12 jyut6 27 hou6 ge3 ziu1 zou2，ngo5 haang4 zo2 loeng5 ci3 heoi3 Tim Hortons ：sau2 sin1，ngo5 sik6 zo2 loeng5 go3 syu4 beng2 tung4 jat1 bui1 jin3 mak6 naai5 bing1 gaa3 fe1。dai6 ji6，ngo5 sik6 zo2 go3 hoeng1 coeng2 daan2 jing1 sik1 sung1 beng2 caan1，baau1 kut3 jat1 go3 haa1 si6 kei4 tung4 jin3 mak6 naai5 bing1 gaa3 fe1。ngo5 heoi3 zo2 sing1 baa1 hak1 jam2 zo2 bui1 jin3 mak6 zau2 naa4 tit3。ngo5 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 ngo5 ge3 fei1 leot6 ban1 pang4 jau5 Greg ，keoi5 hai2 ngo5 zi1 cin4 zau2 zo2。zi1 hau6，ngo5 heoi3 zo2 Yummy Slice ge3 bok6 beng2 dim3，sik6 zo2 go3 hung4 gun3 ho2 hau2 ho2 lok6 ling4 tong4。fei1 leot6 ban1 siu2 faan2 Rose dou1 hai2 dou6，so2 ji5 ngo5 dei6 wu6 soeng1 gong2 zo2 geoi3「san1 nin4 faai3 lok6」。ngo5 ging1 gwo3 gam1 nung4 coeng4 ge3 gwo2 jan4。hai2 ngo5 faan1 uk1 kei2 ge3 lou6 soeng6，hai2 gung1 jyun2 ge3 hong6 zi2 jap6 min6，ngo5 tung4 ngo5 ge3 fei1 dip2 hok6 gaa1 pang4 jau5，jat1 go3 daan1 mak6 faat3 gwok3 jan4 Michael J. gin3 min6 tung4 king1 gai2。keoi5 jung6 ngo5 tau4 soeng6 ge3 hung4 sik1 tau4 gan1 lai4 zi6 jyu4 zi6 lok6，soeng6 min6 jau5 caang2 sik1 ge3 taap3 gaa1 lok3 man4 zi6 mou5：「MGA AWSTRALYA ANG MGA ESTRELYA 」（sing1 sing1 hai6 ou3 zau1 jan4）。ngo5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 ni1 go3 hai6 gwaan1 jyu1「taai3 hung1 zik6 man4」。jau5 kei4 taa1 sai3 gaai3 ge3 laang5 tung4 jit6 saa1 mok6。jin4 hau6，ngo5 heoi3 zo2 ngo5「ji1 ji1」leon4 geoi1 Tita Zeny ge3 uk1 kei2，lo2 keoi5 zi6 gaa1 zai3 ge3「 dinuguán 」waak6 ze2 fei1 leot6 ban1 zyu1 hyut3 dan6 daai3 faan1 uk1 kei2。hai2 uk1 kei2 ge3 ng5 caan1 wui2 baau1 kut3 fei1 leot6 ban1 gai1「aa3 do1 bo1」。
text: 今個冬天溫暖過平時，到目前為止，冇落雪，呢度露露島。喺2024年12月27號嘅朝早，我行咗兩次去 Tim Hortons ：首先，我食咗兩個薯餅同一杯燕麥奶冰咖啡。第二，我食咗個香腸蛋英式鬆餅餐，包括一個哈士奇同燕麥奶冰咖啡。我去咗星巴克飲咗杯燕麥酒拿鐵。我好掛住我嘅菲律賓朋友 Greg ，佢喺我之前走咗。之後，我去咗 Yummy Slice 嘅薄餅店，食咗個紅罐可口可樂零糖。菲律賓小販 Rose 都喺度，所以我哋互相講咗句「新年快樂」。我經過金農場嘅果仁。喺我返屋企嘅路上，喺公園嘅巷子入面，我同我嘅飛碟學家朋友，一個丹麥法國人 Michael J. 見面同傾偈。佢用我頭上嘅紅色頭巾嚟自娱自樂，上面有橙色嘅塔加洛文字母：「MGA AWSTRALYA ANG MGA ESTRELYA 」（星星係澳洲人）。我同佢講呢個係關於「太空殖民」。有其他世界嘅冷同熱沙漠。然後，我去咗我「姨姨」鄰居Tita Zeny 嘅屋企，攞佢自家製嘅「 dinuguán 」或者菲律賓豬血燉帶返屋企。喺屋企嘅午餐會包括菲律賓雞「阿多波」。
